verification: All twelve ROMs and symbol files match their entries in the pinned official ZIP (mts-20260714-0944-31510e1/emulator-only/mbc1/); source blob SHAs taken from the GitHub tree at the pinned revision (checked 2026-11-27)
target: DMG current skipped-boot model with the #91 MBC1 contract (docs/tasks/MBC1.md)
components: Inherit official prebuilt WLA-DX workflow, MIT notice and separate Darkrose font provenance/limits from the shared manifest; no independently reproduced build or binary redistribution
reporting: Audited bodies write no SB/SC; all report through common quit (quit_ok, quit_failure_string, quit_inline). Require the first packet and B/C/D/E/H/L signature. Headers declare MBC1 (0147 = 01 or 03); all sources but ram_256kb say their results were verified on a flash cartridge with a genuine MBC1B1 chip.
limits_review: The bodies have no LY or timer waits. Measured against a scratch reference on 2026-11-27: rom_* 232,348 M-cycles; ram_64kb 969,699 and ram_256kb 969,702; bits_bank1 3,129,085, bits_bank2 3,076,416, bits_mode 3,129,088; bits_ramg 6,113,608 (it rewrites RAMG at each of the 8,192 addresses 0000-1FFF). Caps in tests/cpu_rom_runner.rs: the default 1,000,000 for rom_*, 1,500,000 for ram_*, 4,000,000 for bits_bank1/bank2/mode, 8,000,000 for bits_ramg; the 10 host-second cap is kept (bits_ramg took 2.4 s in a debug build).
excluded: emulator-only/mbc1/multicart_rom_8Mb (MBC1M multicart wiring, out of M5 by decision 1; expected to fail and recorded as a limit). Source blob 42efdbdd8d1e930257131f98702f3c8673cd5a43, ROM sha256 71147f75818877994cca6a0c4c3f9fedacdd50466e1134b743e9d79844995192.
